synoptic_overview: Slow-moving cold front drifts inland; jet streak overhead supports organized convection.

storm.notes: Embedded thunderstorms produce brief hail cores.

wildfire.notes: Fuel moisture elevated after overnight rain.

alerts: Activate urban ponding advisory for Puget Sound corridor.
Standby convective spotters along I-5 belt.
preparedness_actions: Clear storm drains and deploy portable pumps in low-lying intersections.
Coordinate messaging with transportation hubs about slick conditions.

synoptic_overview: Frontal boundary stalls; secondary low near Vancouver Island drives persistent rain shield.

storm.notes: 45 kt southerly gusts persist through afternoon.

alerts: Escalate to flood watch for Chehalis and Snohomish basins.
Notify emergency shelters about potential evacuations within 48 hours.
preparedness_actions: Pre-stage sandbags and barriers at chronic flood nodes.
Initiate daily levee inspections and log seepage observations.

synoptic_overview: Shortwave ridge briefly settles; showers taper but saturated soils remain sensitive.

storm.notes: Scattered showers with isolated rumbles.

flood.notes: Tributaries cresting near action stage.

alerts: Maintain flood watch downstream of saturated basins.
Advise landslide watch for steep terrain near recent burn scars.
preparedness_actions: Survey hillside communities for slope instability signs.
Replenish shelter supplies in coastal counties.

synoptic_overview: Atmospheric river reloads and aligns with stalled boundary over Willamette Valley.

storm.notes: Convective elements within AR produce damaging gusts.

alerts: Upgrade to flood warning for lower Columbia tributaries.
Coordinate with DOT on potential road closures due to mudslides.
preparedness_actions: Deploy high-water rescue teams to western valleys.
Broadcast flood safety messaging across bilingual channels.

synoptic_overview: Moisture plume shifts south; northern counties drying while southern Oregon remains under heavy rain.

storm.notes: Localized thunderstorms along retreating boundary.

flood.notes: Southern watersheds still climbing.

seismic.notes: Slight uptick in tremor near Blanco fracture zone.

alerts: Maintain flood warning south of Eugene.
Issue debris flow advisory for burn scar near Rogue River.
preparedness_actions: Check culverts and drainage in mountain passes for blockage.
Prepare shelters for potential mudflow evacuees.

synoptic_overview: Brief lull as ridge amplifies; grounds begin drying though rivers remain high.

storm.notes: Passing stratiform rain only.

flood.notes: Residual high water on lower Columbia.

alerts: Downgrade most flood warnings to advisories but keep high-water signage.
Monitor levees for delayed seepage.
preparedness_actions: Conduct post-event infrastructure assessments.
Catalog community needs for recovery assistance.

synoptic_overview: Cut-off low organizes 900 km west-southwest; projected to curve toward coast within five days.

storm.notes: Swells build but impacts stay offshore.

flood.notes: Rivers falling yet soils remain moist.

alerts: Begin tracking potential cyclone development in incident action plans.
Notify fisheries of increasing swell heights by Day 5.
preparedness_actions: Review evacuation routing for coastal communities in case of future landfall.
Inspect backup power at emergency operations centers.

synoptic_overview: Developing cyclone deepens to 985 mb; forecast cone includes central Oregon coastline in 96 hours.

storm.notes: Model consensus for hurricane-force gusts along headlands.

flood.notes: Antecedent saturation increases runoff potential.

alerts: Issue hurricane-force wind watch for coastal capes.
Trigger multi-county coordination call for potential evacuations.
preparedness_actions: Stage generators and temporary shelters inland.
Pre-position utility crews for rapid power restoration.

synoptic_overview: Cyclone accelerates northeast; landfall probability increases for north coast within 72 hours.

flood.notes: Storm surge 1.2 m atop high tide threatens harbor districts.

heat.notes: Dense cloud shield keeps temps cool.

alerts: Upgrade to hurricane-force wind warning for north coast counties.
Issue coastal flood warning for bays and estuaries.
preparedness_actions: Execute voluntary evacuations in surge-prone zones.
Harden communication towers and verify redundancy.

synoptic_overview: Cyclone makes landfall overnight; post-tropical transition pushes gale-force winds inland.

storm.notes: Wind gusts 70 kt inland, widespread treefall potential.

flood.notes: Urban flash flooding and minor river flooding ongoing.

seismic.notes: Strong wave action masks small tremor changes.

alerts: Maintain high wind warning and expand inland coverage.
Extend flash flood warnings across metro corridors.
preparedness_actions: Deploy damage assessment teams at first light.
Coordinate debris clearance crews to priority routes.

synoptic_overview: Storm exits; wraparound showers continue while rivers crest.

flood.notes: Several rivers crest in minor to moderate flood stage.

alerts: Keep river flood warnings active until crests pass.
Monitor saturated slopes for delayed slides.
preparedness_actions: Support community relief centers with additional staffing.
Document infrastructure impacts for recovery funding.

synoptic_overview: Transient ridge brings calmer conditions; cool nights increase fog formation.

storm.notes: Only isolated drizzle along coast.

flood.notes: Floodwaters recede though some fields remain inundated.

heat.notes: Overnight lows dip but stay above freezing.

alerts: Cancel remaining wind headlines; maintain residual flood advisories.
Issue dense fog outlook for river valleys at dawn.
preparedness_actions: Repair temporary levees and reinforce weak points.
Shift focus to debris removal from secondary roads.

synoptic_overview: Deepening inland trough drives continental air southward; mountain snow levels fall to 1200 m.

storm.notes: Snow squalls along Cascades create whiteout bursts.

flood.notes: Rising snowpack slows runoff.

wildfire.notes: Cold damp air keeps fuels saturated.

alerts: Post winter weather watch for mountain passes.
Advise transporters of potential chain controls within 72 hours.
preparedness_actions: Stage plow crews and abrasives at high elevation depots.
Review avalanche response protocols with ski patrol partners.

synoptic_overview: Inland trough sharpens; Arctic-origin air mass poised to drop south after Halloween.

storm.notes: Strong pressure gradient sets up gusty easterlies in Columbia Gorge.

flood.notes: River levels near bankfull but trending downward.

alerts: Issue freeze watch for interior valleys by Day 3.
Highlight strong gorge winds for utility partners.
preparedness_actions: Prepare warming shelters for vulnerable populations.
Inspect power infrastructure for wind vulnerability.

synoptic_overview: Early-season snowstorm organizes east of Cascades with deep moisture plume meeting cold air.

storm.notes: Blizzard potential along Blue Mountains and interior Columbia Plateau.

flood.notes: Frozen precipitation limits runoff.

alerts: Post blizzard watch for interior northwest counties.
Issue wind chill advisory for exposed plateaus.
preparedness_actions: Stockpile fuel and food supplies at rural shelters.
Schedule continuity-of-operations drills for remote sites.

synoptic_overview: Snowstorm peaks; heavy wet snow accumulates across interior while coast remains rainy and cold.

storm.notes: Whiteout conditions east of Cascades, gusts 50 kt.

flood.notes: Minor ice jams possible on smaller streams.

seismic.notes: Seismic noise from wind and surf elevated.

alerts: Upgrade blizzard watch to warning for interior counties.
Issue travel ban guidance for exposed rural highways.
preparedness_actions: Deploy search-and-rescue teams with tracked vehicles on standby.
Coordinate with utilities on rapid snow load assessments.

synoptic_overview: Storm exits; cold air entrenched with clear nights encouraging hard freeze regionwide.

storm.notes: Lingering snow showers diminish.

flood.notes: Runoff frozen in place.

alerts: Maintain hard freeze warning for agricultural zones.
Advise homeowners to protect vulnerable plumbing.
preparedness_actions: Activate warming centers during overnight hours.
Inspect shelters for generator readiness.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: High pressure shifts east; southerly return flow begins moderating temperatures.

storm.notes: Light warm-advection showers late.

flood.notes: Frozen soils delay runoff.

heat.notes: Diurnal swings widen but mornings remain cold.

alerts: Downgrade freeze warnings but keep frost advisories in valleys.
Notify growers of gradual thaw to plan irrigation blowouts.
preparedness_actions: Assess roads for refreezing after sunset.
Continue distribution of cold-weather supplies to houseless residents.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: Strong subtropical jet aims at region; new Pacific storm due within 72 hours.

storm.notes: Increasing mid-level winds signal next storm cycle.

flood.notes: Snowpack will enhance runoff once warm sector arrives.

heat.notes: Mild daytime highs but cold nights persist.

alerts: Initiate coordination call for potential rain-on-snow event.
Alert avalanche centers about impending warm pulse.
preparedness_actions: Model runoff scenarios using updated snow water equivalent data.
Pre-stage barrier materials near chronic slide areas.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: Warm sector surges inland; freezing levels jump to 2500 m triggering rain-on-snow response.

flood.notes: Rain-on-snow melt drives sharp river rises.

alerts: Upgrade to flood watch for Cascade-fed rivers.
Prepare swiftwater teams for potential rescues.
preparedness_actions: Issue targeted alerts to river communities and recreation outfitters.
Test emergency notification system for flood messaging.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: Cold front sweeps through; post-frontal showers accompanied by isolated thunderstorms.

storm.notes: Thunderstorms capable of small hail and funnel clouds.

flood.notes: Rivers crest but hold below major flood.

alerts: Maintain flood watch through crest cycle.
Issue special weather statement for small hail potential.
preparedness_actions: Monitor levees for rapid stage changes overnight.
Document thunderstorm reports to refine warning thresholds.

flood.notes: Groundwater responds with seep issues in basements.

Release guidance on basement pump usage and mold prevention.
preparedness_actions: Coordinate with public works on seepage mitigation.
Provide community workshops on post-flood cleanup safety.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: Pattern break; high pressure builds with dry easterly flow promoting rapid drying.

flood.notes: Rivers recede to normal levels.

wildfire.notes: Dry east winds lower fuel moisture.

alerts: Cancel flood advisories; note drying trend.
Issue fire weather watch east of Cascades if humidity drops below 20%.
preparedness_actions: Inspect recent burn scars for new drying cracks.
Coordinate with forestry partners on patrol coverage.

hazard_ratings.synoptic_overview: Offshore flow intensifies; downslope warming spikes temperatures east of Cascades.

storm.notes: No significant storm activity.

flood.notes: Dry spell continues.

wildfire.notes: Single-digit humidity and gusty winds elevate fire spread potential.

alerts: Issue red flag warning for Columbia Basin and Okanogan Highlands.
Alert utilities to increased wildfire ignition risk near transmission corridors.
preparedness_actions: Pre-position wildfire strike teams along transport corridors.
Enforce burn bans and patrol for illegal burns.

flood.notes: No hydrologic threat.

storm.notes: Isolated showers possible mainly along coast.

flood.notes: Rivers steady.
